measurement_notes.scope: Frozen 33-row development set only; 27 verified source rows determine evidence recall.
measurement_notes.verified_source_recovered: Verified decisions whose every cited evidence turn is within the measured retrieval scope, not a count of all plausible candidates.
measurement_notes.verified_all_evidence_in_20: The unchanged initial lineage-aware 20-turn envelope contains every cited evidence turn for 24 of 27 verified sources.
measurement_notes.retrieval_payload_tokens: Summed normalized-message local-tokenizer proxy for the union of the initial 20-turn scope and each nearby-session fallback (or the initial scope alone at baseline). Repeated sessions count once per decision. This is not billed cost or the conditionally read curator payload.
measurement_notes.runtime_seconds: Not measured consistently across strategies; null prevents an invented runtime gain.
measurement_notes.conditional_oracle_excluded: The gold-aware conditional fallback is a cost upper bound, not an operational trigger.
